M. de Coussemaker has published in the “Annales Archéologiques” the figure of a crowned personage playing the lyre, which he found in a manuscript of the ninth or tenth century in the library at Angers. The player twangs the strings with his fingers, while the Anglo-saxon gleeman before mentioned uses a plectrum. _Cithara_ was a name applied to several stringed instruments greatly varying in form, power of sound, and compass. The illustration represents a cithara from a manuscript of the ninth century, formerly in the library of the great

Every relation MUST include an evidence field. Before returning, verify all entities have all four required keys: id, name, type, evidence. Omit unsupported items. Use empty lists when appropriate. Return compact JSON without indentation. Do not repeat entities or relations. Do not create generic category nodes such as hotel or person merely to express an entity type. A relation must connect two independently identified entities and its evidence must support that specific pair.
